label: Ruthlessly Ambitious
notes: Actively seeks the throne. Will found a faction given any grievance.

label: Content
notes: Never initiates a faction. Can still be recruited into one.

label: Devoted
notes: Loyalty cannot fall below 30 unless you execute their kin.

label: Treacherous
notes: May leak council decisions to a rival kingdom.

label: Honest
notes: Advice never conceals bad news. Corruption gain near zero.

label: Venal
notes: Siphons a share of any budget passing through their domain.

label: Bold
notes: Advice skews to high-risk high-reward. Favours assault over siege.

label: Cautious
notes: Advice skews conservative. Reduces critical failure chance in their domain.

label: Pious
notes: Opposes taxing or seizing from the church. Improves clergy opinion.

label: Worldly
notes: Indifferent to religious concerns. Better at realpolitik.

label: Compassionate
notes: Pushes hard for famine relief. Opposes harsh justice.

label: Cruel
notes: Suppression is more effective under them. Peasant contentment suffers.

label: Vain
notes: Responds strongly to titles and public honours. Cheap to buy off.

label: Humble
notes: Honours have little effect. Harder to appease without real concessions.

label: Wrathful
notes: May escalate a council argument into a personal feud.

label: Patient
notes: Slow to form grievances. Grudges last far longer once formed.

label: Paranoid
notes: Higher chance to uncover conspiracies. Also invents ones that do not exist.

label: Trusting
notes: Vulnerable to being recruited by a faction without realising it.

label: Brilliant
notes: Exceptional across the board. Rare. Dangerous if disloyal.

label: Slow
notes: Loyal but ineffective. Cheap to keep. Costs you outcomes.

label: Gifted Administrator
notes: Plus admin capacity when seated as Chancellor.

label: Born Soldier
notes: Large battle bonus when commanding personally.

label: Schemer
notes: Excellent spymaster. Will eventually plot against someone.

label: Forthright
notes: Terrible at intrigue. Impossible to bribe.

label: Silver Tongued
notes: Major bonus to diplomacy and to swaying council debates.

label: Blunt
notes: Offends foreign envoys. Never lies to you.

label: Shrewd Trader
notes: Improves trade income and loan terms as Steward.

label: Learned
notes: Accelerates the tech category they are set to oversee.

label: High Nobility
notes: Brings noble loyalty. Expects privileges. Furious if passed over.

label: Lowborn
notes: Loyal because you raised them. Nobles resent their presence.

label: Church Trained
notes: Bridges crown and church. Cannot inherit secular titles.

label: Foreign Born
notes: Excellent at diplomacy with their homeland. Trusted by no one else.

label: Merchant Family
notes: Burgher favour bonus. Nobles view them as an upstart.

label: War Veteran
notes: Battle-tested. Suffers a morale penalty if you lose badly.

label: Royal Blood
notes: Has a real claim. The most dangerous faction leader in the game.

label: Disgraced
notes: Acquired after public humiliation. Never fully forgives.

label: Honoured
notes: Acquired after a major public reward. Decays over about ten years.

label: Grieving
notes: Acquired on death of close kin. Fades after roughly two years.

label: Maimed
notes: Cannot command in battle. Acquired from war or a failed duel.

label: Sickly
notes: Elevated annual death chance. Worsens sharply past fifty.

label: Vigorous
notes: Reduced death chance. Likely to outlive several of your reigns.

label: Master Duelist
notes: Feared blade. Wins almost any duel a feud escalates into.

label: Beloved of the Crowds
notes: Commoners adore them. Their public stance moves peasant contentment.

label: Firebrand Preacher
notes: Can raise or calm a mob with a sermon. The church distrusts what it cannot appoint.

label: Crowned Head
notes: Rules a realm of their own. Cannot be recruited or purged; only outmaneuvered.
